anya (docs): Heads-up: OpenAPI for POST /v1/generate currently shows `input` as an object in the request examples, but runtime accepts both string and array. Saw a customer bug where the JS SDK sent an array and the docs curl sample returned 400.

matt (platform): Ugh, which example file is that?

anya (docs): docs/reference/generate.yaml example under `requestBody` — it has `input: { text: \"...\" }` vs our JS SDK snippet that sends `input: [\"a\",\"b\"]`. Repro steps: run the curl sample in the page -> 400. :eyes:

lee (sdk): I bumped into this yesterday too. The SDK README shows `input` as an array for batching, but the OpenAPI example only shows the object form. Runtime tolerates both, so users get confused when examples disagree.

anya (docs): Proposed fix: update the OpenAPI examples to demonstrate both shapes and add a short note about array batching. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :speech_balloon:

matt (platform): Can you paste the minimal OpenAPI snippet you'd like? I can modify the example generator if needed.

anya (docs): Sure — please use this in the `requestBody` examples: 
```yaml
requestBody:
  content:
    application/json:
      examples:
        batchInput:
          summary: Batching example
          value:
            input: [\"Summarize this\", \"Translate to fr\"]
            model: \"redwood-alpha-1\"
        singleInput:
          summary: Single-input object form
          value:
            input:
              text: \"Summarize short note\"
            model: \"redwood-alpha-1\"
```
Also add a short note above examples: `Note: the \"input\" field accepts either a single string/object for one item or an array for batching. Prefer arrays for multi-input requests.`

lee (sdk): Thanks — also update the JS snippet to `client.generate({ model, input: [\"...\"] })` (not `input: {text: ...}`). I'll push a tiny fix into the PR to sync examples with snippets.

doc-bot: Automated update: PR opened by anya — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 (CI: docs-lint ✅, link-checker: pending).

matt (platform): Nice. Can someone add a one-line migration note on the Generate API page plus a curl example using a JSON array? If CI passes I'll merge.

anya (docs): On it — adding the curl and a short migration blurb in the same PR now. cc @eng-ml for visibility and to confirm we don't need a runtime change.

lee (sdk): Quick patch pushed to the PR to update the SDK example. Will run the snippet tests locally and report back.

matt (platform): Great — thanks all. After merge I'll trigger the docs deploy so the live page matches the SDK examples. :shipit:
